Titles.jpn: ギャグマンガ日和

Summaries.eng: Known for its hyperactive, random, and nonsensical style that revolves around various plots and characters throughout the series. It makes absolutely no sense.
Summaries.jpn: 『ギャグマンガ日和』（ギャグマンガびより、ラテン文字表記：Gag Manga Biyori）は、増田こうすけによる日本のギャグ漫画、およびそのアニメ化作品。現在は『ギャグマンガ日和GB』と改題し、『ジャンプスクエア』にて連載中。

Summaries.eng: When Saki, an up and coming idol, holds an autograph session and not a single soul turns up, her hapless editor is at a loss as to what to do. In his infinite wisdom the young man decides that threatening a nearby elementary school kid is then best way to go! However, when that fails it seems that his only choice is to hold an autograph showdown between Saki and the psychotic idol wannabe, Bururu. Then, when a reckless teenager makes a bungled attempt to summon Satan, he and his friends must try and send the devil back to the underworld, but with their attempts just making him all the more infuriated will they emerge from the experience unscathed?

Titles.jpn: シール／シール2

Summaries.eng:
The CEO of the Uki-Uki Confectionary talks about the new product - the Dokkiri-chan Chocco (with a free sticker inside), and he wants to talk to the product development department. It appears that the stickers in the packages are all of a depressed (and mentally damaged) boy, and this is why the product is not selling well.

In the second part, the CEO of the Macho Bread Corp goes down to the mall for a new Doki-Doki Bread. He opens to reveal... 3 Takeru-stickers in a row. The CEO knew that something wrong is going on.
Summaries.jpn: 「こんなの売れるか～（怒）!」　期待の新商品ドッキリチャンチョコに同封されたシールとは!?　商品開発の驚くべき真実が明かされる!

Titles.eng: Yang-Ti Gets Angry! The Sovereign Letter
Titles.jpn: 煬帝怒る（国書編）

Summaries.eng: Prince Shōtoku along with Ono no Imoko have become Kenzuishi, imperial embassies to China. They were to meet the Chinese Emperor Yang of Sui and were heading to Luoyang by ship. They are, however, suffering from long-term travel insanity.
Summaries.jpn: 聖徳太子と小野妹子は、赤＆青のジャージ姿で隋国へ旅立った。歴史的に有名な聖徳太子の国書はこうして作られた!　「同情するなら墨汁をくれ～!」

Titles.jpn: 煬帝怒る（洛陽編）

Summaries.eng: Prince Shōtoku and Ono no Imoko arrive at their destination: Luoyang. They go to meet the Chinese Emperor Yang of Sui (who is really an alien from the planet Octopus pretending to be human and manipulating the people's minds) to give him the letter from the Emperor of Japan. However, in doing so, things go quickly and horribly wrong.
Summaries.jpn: 隋の皇帝はナント宇宙人であった!（…え、マジで?!）それも気にせず喧嘩を始めてしまう太子と妹子だが―。

Titles.jpn: 終末

Summaries.eng: It is only three more mere hours till a giant meteor hits the Earth, wiping out all life forever. The world is in total chaos and insanity with the knowledge that in three hours the apocalypse will come. A TV station has invited five celebrities to talk about the end of the planet Earth - unfortunately, they are also affected by the worldwide chaos, as they show their true colors... and none of them are too pretty.
Summaries.jpn: あと３時間で地球が滅びる…今こそ、大人気アイドルや大物演歌歌手など芸能人が全てを番組で暴露する!　驚愕の生放送を目撃せよ!「わたし、休日はもっぱら鼻くそほじってます」???

Titles.jpn: 奥の細道 エピソードI

Summaries.eng: In 1689, the well-known poet (and wimpy looney) Matsuo Bashō took his apprentice, the "apprentice-teaches-master" Sora as his travelling company, and started a journey towards the narrow road to the deep north. This is the beginning of their story - and, in extension, their madness.
Summaries.jpn: 芭蕉の臭い家へと招かれた弟子の曾良くん。無礼きわまりないその態度に、俳聖たる松尾芭蕉は…「ちょっと恥ずかしい物とかも出すからこの際! そんなすぐに帰らんといて――!」

Titles.jpn: ハリスインパクト 〜ビックリ大作戦〜

Summaries.eng: Consulate Townsend Harris and his Hollander personal secretary Heusken go to Japan to finalize the Treaty of Peace and Commerce. However, Harris is more absorbed in his plan to leave a historic impact to the Japanese - something that only results in madness. He made a plan for their trip in Edo - which is actually insane pictures of his visions of failure and success, including a drawing of Heusken smiling - while blood is flowing down from his mouth.
Summaries.jpn: 「土とか喰ってみようかな…」米国総領事タウンゼント・ハリスは3年前に日本に来た黒船（ペリー提督）に負けないインパクトを目指して奮闘する……が？

Titles.jpn: ハリスインパクト （乗り込み編）

Summaries.eng: Harris and Heusken are ready to finalize the treaty, and they are going with a strange vehicle that Harris already made. Will Heusken survive this abomination of an invention that'll make him go up and down? Will the treaty be passed? Or is this the ultimate death knell for the Treaty of Peace and Commerce - and the world's sanity?
Summaries.jpn: ヘンな乗り物作っちゃったハリス。嫌がるヒュースケンを連れて宣伝活動開始!「キャッホーー! ゆけえーー! どこまでもゆけえーー!」

Titles.eng: Go Omusubi-kun / Light Speed Rider Mach Ryou
Titles.jpn: どっこい!おむすび君／光速ライダー マッハ涼

Summaries.eng: The first part of this episode is a Doraemon parody about an alien called Omusubi-kun and the boy he lives with, Hebota, as they live together until Omusubi-kun, after having his insides revealed, leaves the planet Earth for good. The second part is about Mach Ryou, a motorbike racer who raced against a punk over a girl at the deadly cliff road. The resulting race escalates into an all-out cliff joyride as Ryou and the punk race for the ultimate prize.
Summaries.jpn:
「どっこいおむすび君」
「おなかが空いたら僕の頭を食べな」おむすび君とヘボ太くんの心温まる物語。
「光速ライダー マッハ涼」
「こんなナナメになっている～!」伝説のライダーたちの勝負の行方は？

Titles.jpn: 魔法少女誕生

Summaries.eng: The Ramen Fairy, one of the fairies that are sent to the degenerating Japan by the Queen of Fairies, is found by a girl inside a ramen cup - with a chopstick-stabbing first contact. He asks the girl to become a magical girl - which, however, yields unexpectedly disastrous results.
Summaries.jpn: ラーメンの精が魔法ステッキ（ホンミョンボ）を持ってやってきた。すさんだ日本を救うため、高3受験少女は華麗に変身する。

Titles.eng: Saiyuki: The End of the Journey
Titles.jpn: 西遊記〜旅の終わり〜

Summaries.eng: Xuanzang and his comrades are at the end of their journey to India, and they are racing to reach the goal first. Xuanzang tries to keep his comrades from cheating by reminding them of their dead friend Zhu Bajie. However, during these events, total chaos erupts and the truth about how Zhu Bajie died is revealed.
Summaries.jpn: 旅の終わりをむかえた三蔵法師たち。誰が最初にゴールするかモメテしまい…。 三蔵法師の驚くべき特殊能力とは？

Titles.eng: I Am Dead and I Scream at the Sun / Unlucky Friends
Titles.jpn: 死んだ私は太陽にほえる／アンラッキーフレンズ

Summaries.eng: Sayuri, who died due to a falling swordfish pierceing her stomach when saving a cat holding that swordfish from being run over by a car, asks the Grim Reaper to let her come to life again for a few seconds to say the words she wishes to be her last words - however, stomachache and interference by a teacher named Gorimatsu led to botched attempts of saying "What the hell is that?!" as her last words. The second part is about a girl called Ishii who has gone to college, living on her own, and sees her friends and neighbors fall from their weakening verdanas while she is running home - the casualty toll increases till she is the last one to fall subject to her own verdana.
Summaries.jpn:
「死んだ私は太陽にほえる」
猫を助けようとして死んでしまったさゆり。「なんじゃこりゃ～」と言って死にたい…5秒だけ生き返らせてと死神に訴えるが。
「アンラッキーフレンズ」
雨の中洗濯物を取り込みに帰る途中、次々と知人たちが…!

Titles.eng: You're a Detective Usami-chan? / She's a Great Detective!
Titles.jpn: 名探偵っスか!うさみちゃん／名探偵だもの!うさみちゃん

Summaries.eng: This final episode of the season is about Usami-chan, a rabbit girl who is known for her detective abilities and sharp intuition that exposes the criminal responsible for he crimes. She solves unusual and perverted cases that happens around her - and her prime suspect, the bear boy Kumakichi.
Summaries.jpn: 学校で次々に起こる事件に名探偵うさみちゃんの目が鋭くなる!

Titles.jpn: 名探偵だぞえ！うさみちゃん

Summaries.eng: Usami-chan, the detective rabbit girl, continues solving more far out of the ordinary and perverted cases in her school, this time with the help of the transfer student Penske-kun - which his detective abilities involve exposing his downright hideous teeth.
Summaries.jpn: 通報大好きうさみちゃん。ライバルのペン介君が登場だよ！

Titles.jpn: 来ないよ！家庭教師

Summaries.eng: A father of the family hired a private tutor for his son, tempted by the fact that the tutors were advertised as hot college girls. There is only one major problem, though: the private tutor doesn't come despite repeated phone calls, cakes, meditation, and etc. by the father and son for several days.
Summaries.jpn: 美人女子大生の家庭教師を心待ちにする父と息子。待てども家庭教師は来ず…。

Titles.jpn: 聖徳太子の楽しい木造建築

Summaries.eng: Prince Shoutoku returns from his trip to China and after the Luoyang incident to check on the construction progress of the Hōryū-ji temple, only to find it to be still on the planning stage. He forces the only worker to finish the building in a day - although in a severely altered form - so he can invite Ono no Imoko over - however, that action would would be the last for both of them.
Summaries.jpn: 法隆寺の建立祝いに妹子を招待する太子。急遽1日で作り上げたその建物は恐ろしいボロ屋で…。

Titles.jpn: ネコちゃんの腹筋／5つ子大家族

Summaries.eng: The first part is about a humanoid cat who trains his abdominal muscles, but he, unfortunately, broke them when training using a basketball, so he shared the muscles with his grandmother in order to recoup his ab losses. The second part is about a television crew trying to film the quintuplets of a family by all means and at all costs, who appear to be far, far more hyperactive than usual.
Summaries.jpn:
「ネコちゃんの腹筋」
腹筋を鍛えているネコちゃんのお話。
「5つ子大家族」
5つ子を撮影に来た番組ディレクターは、家に隠れる子供たちを追う！

Titles.jpn: がんばれ浦島太郎

Summaries.eng: Urashima saves a turtle and gets invited to the Ryūgū-jō, where, to the dismay of Urashima, the princess Otohime despised him and gave him the lowest quality service possible - just to overload his brain to the breaking point.
Summaries.jpn: 助けたカメに連れられて竜宮城に来てみれば、質素なもてなしと、とんでもない土産を持たされてしまった。

Titles.jpn: ソードマスターヤマト－誤植篇－－完結篇－

Summaries.eng: In the first part, a mangaka phones his editor to complain about the outrageous and insane typos that appeared on his manga, Swordmaster Yamato. In the second part, a new editor, Takara-san, phones the mangaka to tell him that his manga has to end abruptly because of its low popularity, despite the story becoming intense. The mangaka is allowed three pages to end it - which, for a manga becoming intense, is absoulte madness to the mangaka.
Summaries.jpn: 「ちょっと～、これ誤植ですよ！」マンガ家の訴えに編集部の態度は…。

Titles.eng: The Mogami River, Gathering Rain of May and Even More Rapid
Titles.jpn: 五月雨をあつめて早し最上川

Summaries.eng: Taking up where Episode 1 left off, Matsuo Bashō and his apprentice Sora continue their journey to the North, this time getting to cross Mogami river. Unfortunately, still suffering from his inferiority complex, thinking he is strong enough to block the river, and having saw his teddy bear sabotaged by Sora, Matsuo jumps into the rapid river, causing more insanity than ever before.
Summaries.jpn: 最上川を船で下る芭蕉と曽良。ひょんなことから曽良の仕業で傷つけられたマーフィー君に気づき、芭蕉は激怒するが!?

Titles.eng: Akio - You Still Live Inside my Heart / Goodbye, Grandpa
Titles.jpn: 明男/さよならおじいちゃん

Summaries.eng: This episode involves the tragic moment in life that is death. In the first half, Reiko-chan must cope with the death of Akio, a weird, 4-legged, 3-eyed, severely malfunctioning robot she loved so much, with her still functioning partner, the centauroid Mamoru, which, of course, also suffers from strange malfunctions and mishaps. On the second half, the grandfather of a family, with his time running out, recalls the memories he had with his old friends - only to encounter severe and weird anomalies.
Summaries.jpn:
「明男」
センチメンタルな恋と友情の三角関係の物語。
「さよならおじいちゃん」
危篤のおじいちゃんは、夢の中、友人のエスパー乳毛(ちちげ)と再会する。

Titles.eng: Eyepatch -Real Momotarou- / Ikkyu-san / Forbidden Canadajare BEST5
Titles.jpn: 眼帯－真桃太郎－／一休さん

Summaries.eng: An elderly couple slices open a giant peach and finds Date Masamune's eyepatch inside, they fight over it while keeping it a secret to Date Masamune, who comes looking for his lost eyepatch. The second part reveals that the witty Ikkyu gets his inspiration by summoning the god of wit. This time, however, the god of sexual harassment gets summoned instead when Ikkyu is tested by a daimyo, resulting in a pretty awkward situation. The final part is... just a list of dajare.
Summaries.jpn:
「眼帯－真桃太郎－」
政宗が落とした眼帯を拾ったおじいさんとおばあさんは、桃太郎と名づけて大切にしていました。
「一休さん」
一休に呼ばれたとんちの神に代わり、セクハラの神が憑依してしまった。

Titles.eng: The Legend of the Manga Prep School: Hurricane Jun
Titles.jpn: マンガ専門学校伝説 ハリケーン準

Summaries.eng: Whereever there is corrupt manga forces causing madness and chaos, Hurricane Jun will be there to stop it before it's too late - using powerful manga pages that turns the pain involved in them into reality for the enemy.
Summaries.jpn: マンガ専門学校は、漫力がすべての弱肉強食の世界。君臨する四天王にハリケーン準が挑む！

Titles.jpn: 黒登山

Summaries.eng: A student gets immediately forced into his teacher's "black mountain climbing" club, where its members (just the two of them) do erratic and weird things to distract other mountaineers and put them in grave danger.
Summaries.jpn: 黒登山部に無理やり入部させられた丸本。顧問の教師と共に山へ登ることになるが…。

Titles.jpn: ラヴ江

Summaries.eng: A single man buys a robot girlfriend for himself, but, unfortunately for him, it turns out the product wasn't like what he expected. The robot then proceeds to help him get a real girlfriend, scaring random bystanders and causing pretty severe damage to his physical health in the process.
Summaries.jpn: ロボット研究所から派遣されたセクシーボディ・ラヴ江。彼女を探すご主人のために大奮闘！

Titles.eng: Hirata's World / Speak of the detective! Usami-chan
Titles.jpn: 平田の世界／うさみちゃんVS怪盗

Summaries.eng: Hirata came to a realization that he is only a manga character in a barren world, he hopes for a rival to appear like in typical Shōnen manga, and he was granted one - wearing panties on his head. After frequent appearances made by other, weird creatures and supposedly defeating the evil lord, Hirata came to the slow - and awkward - realization that he is actually in a gag manga. The second part continues Usami-chan's adventures in solving more perverted cases in the school.
Summaries.jpn:
「平田の世界」
マンガの世界の住人、平田平男が紡ぐ物語とは!?
「うさみちゃんVS怪盗」
怪盗バアズアイとうさみちゃん、世紀の対決。

Titles.eng: The Wonders of the Sympetrum / It's the Detective! Usami-chan
Titles.jpn: アカトンボのふしぎ／最後はやっぱりうさみちゃんが事件解決！

Summaries.eng: In the first part, a perverted professor gives a lesson about meadowhawks - with pretty mixed results. In the second part, Usami-chan and friends try to cheer Penske-kun up since he became quickly disliked for his hideous teeth.
Summaries.jpn:
「アカトンボのふしぎ」
昆虫のふしぎシリーズ。今回はアカトンボのふしぎだよ。
「最後はやっぱりうさみちゃんが事件解決！」
ペン介君との友情。そしてその影に潜むものとは…。

Titles.jpn: 聖徳1週間

Summaries.eng: Prince Shōtoku digs up a pitfall trap, which he hopes that Ono no Imoko will fall into. However, Ono no Imoko happens to see him laying this trap and spends the whole week spying on Prince Shōtoku as he waits for Imoko to fall into the trap. Will Imoko wound up truly falling into it? Only time will tell. Also of interest to note, there is a new seiyū for Ono no Imoko in this episode - and it's a pretty girly one to boot.
Summaries.jpn: 妹子が観察する太子の1週間。太子の素顔が明かされる!?

Titles.eng: Magnificent Yoga / Is She Really a Detective! Usami-chan
Titles.jpn: すばらしきヨガ／名探偵うさみちゃん・ブルマーどろぼう許すまじ！

Summaries.eng: In the first part, a poor Yoga master must beg a gangster father for forgiveness, when his son accidentally injures the gangster's son. He is unable to beg successfully and ends up doing random Yoga poses instead, which enrages the gangster father even more. In the second part, Usami-chan tries to figure out who has stolen Nyanmi-chan's bulma - till the usual suspect is revealed.
Summaries.jpn:
「すばらしきヨガ」
ヨガ健康教室で繰り広げられる、究極のヨガ謝罪!!
「名探偵うさみちゃん・ブルマーどろぼう許すまじ！」
ブルマーどろぼう事件でまたまた疑われるクマ吉君。例のごとく無実を叫ぶ。

Titles.jpn: 伊能忠敬の歩み

Summaries.eng: This episode follows Inou Tadataka as he goes on his journey to complete the map of Japan. In the process he meets up with a sickly dog, an out-of-this-world alien, and a strange old lady. Much hilarity and chaos ensues.
Summaries.jpn: 日本地図を作るべく、伊能忠敬はゆかいなお供と測量の旅に！ 伊能図はいかにして作られたか!?

Titles.eng: Lalami Reality / Shoutoku Taishi's Riddle Masterpiece Selection
Titles.jpn: ララ美☆リアリティ／聖徳なぞなぞ傑作選

Summaries.jpn:
「ララ美☆リアリティ」
マンガ家・恋野YOKANと編集者・林田のララ美をめぐるマンガ作り大激論！
「聖徳なぞなぞ傑作選」
太子がみんなに伝えたい、傑作なぞなぞの数々！

Titles.eng: Forever Hunter: Masuda / Super Combining Warriors Sun God V! Opening Theme!
Titles.jpn: フォーエバーハンターMASUDA／超合体戦士サンゴッドVオープニングテーマ

Summaries.jpn:
「フォーエバーハンターMASUDA」
コウスケ マスダ、彼こそギャグマンガ家という名の狩人…。
「超合体戦士サンゴッドVオープニングテーマ」
出動1・2・3！ 悪を討て、サンゴッドV！ 魂のオープニングテーマ!!

Titles.jpn: 恋の季節!!キューピッド君

Summaries.jpn: 恋にときめく倉田君の前に天界からキューピッドが舞い降りた！ 果たして恋の行方は如何に!?

Titles.eng: Non-stop Matsuo Bashou: A Heartwarming Journey to the Northeast
Titles.jpn: 心温まる東北の旅 ノンストップ松尾芭蕉

Summaries.jpn: 旅の道中、変なキノコを食べてしまった芭蕉。俳句の神様を操れる？ 芭蕉と渋谷風流との死闘が始まる…！

Titles.jpn: 決めろ！キラメキシュート－涙の方向転換篇－

Summaries.jpn: マンガ家に迫る打ち切りの危機！ 人気獲得のため、連載漫画は涙の方向転換を余儀なくされる!?

Titles.jpn: スケバン探偵（前編）

Summaries.jpn: スタントロボ・スタ江が織り成す最高のアクションで、映画監督の何かが割れる!!

Titles.eng: Gang Leader Detective Girl: Part 2 / Shoutoku Taishi's Riddle Masterpiece Selection
Titles.jpn: スケバン探偵（後編）／聖徳なぞなぞ傑作選

Summaries.jpn:
「スケバン探偵（後編）」
遂に始まるスタ江と川下陽子の主役争奪戦！ 主演の座を得るのは果たして!?
「聖徳なぞなぞ傑作選」
続・太子がみんなに伝えたい、傑作なぞなぞの数々！

Titles.jpn: ルノアールVSセザンヌ

Summaries.jpn: その日、ルノワールの秘密をつかんだのはライバルのセザンヌだった。秘密を使って戦いを有利に進めようとするセザンヌ。ルノワールもまた、その身体に秘められた武器を使って強力な攻撃を始める！ 芸術の都パリ、後に印象派と呼ばれるルノワールたちが総出演。芸術史の闇に葬られた壮大な絵画対決が始まる！

Titles.jpn: 聖徳1週間

Titles.eng: Let's go to the Bath House!
Titles.jpn: 銭湯に行こう

Summaries.jpn: みなさんは何となく人と同じ行動をとってしまうことってありませんか？ ある日、10周年記念で7割引になっていたスーパー銭湯。多くの人がひきつけられ、そして銭湯の中は大混雑に！ お湯は赤く染まり、水風呂はぬるま湯になり、子供は肩車される!? これはとある銭湯に出かけた高校生2人の命がけの物語です!!!

Titles.jpn: 奥の細道 エピソードI

Titles.eng: Shinsengumi -Ikedaya Case- / The Narrow Road to the Deep North Middle of the Journey (Short Story)
Titles.jpn: 新撰組　—池田屋事件—／奥の細道 旅途中（ショートストーリー）

Summaries.jpn: 最近の新撰組は、何か変だ！ 髪型が変だったり、手の数が人間の3倍あるのは当たり前!? 沖田総司の首はグラグラとして伸び縮みし、土方はごろごろと転がる玉になる！ 池田屋襲撃の夜、京都がえりの大地監督を驚愕させた超絶の戦いが今!?他に「松尾芭蕉ショート」を収録。

Titles.jpn: 名探偵っスか！うさみちゃん／名探偵だもの！うさみちゃん
巨重戦士メンタリオン

Summaries.jpn: 今日も悪の怪獣を倒し日本を守った巨大ロボット「メンタリオン」。だが、ピュアエネルギーシステムで動くメンタリオンのパイロットには、極限のピュアさが求められるのだ！ そのため、日本各地から選りすぐりのピュアニストが集結し、ピュア度を競うトーナメントが始まった!?

Titles.jpn: 西遊記〜旅の終わり〜

Titles.eng: My Best Friend is a Werewolf
Titles.jpn: 親友は狼男

Summaries.jpn: オレには重大な2つの秘密がある。そのうちの1つ、オレが狼男だということが親友のケンジに知られてしまった。しかも狼男となったオレは凶暴な人格に変身してしまう…ケンジに襲いかかるオレ！ だが、その瞬間にオレを襲う影が!? 狼男のナゾが今こそ明かされる！

Titles.jpn: 終末
メカマツオ

Summaries.jpn: 元禄二年五月九日。松尾芭蕉は、弟子の曽良を供につれ「奥の細道」の旅を始めていました。松島へとやってきた芭蕉たち…。しかし、悲劇はそこで起きたのです。曽良の読んだアノ名句と、芭蕉と曽良の絶交の関係とは？ 曽良のナゾのほほえみが嵐を呼ぶ！ そして、ついうっかり未来からやってきたメカマツオの正体とは!?

Titles.jpn: 五月雨をあつめて早し最上川
心温まる東北の旅 ノンストップ松尾芭蕉
名探偵だぞえ！うさみちゃん

Titles.eng: A Love Song of Love for You
Titles.jpn: 恋のラブソングを君に

Summaries.jpn: デビューCDが第1位を獲得した期待の新人アイドル笹島聖斗。彼には思いを寄せる人がいて…。彼女のために歌った聖斗の勇気とピュアで切ない心情と、カップリング曲に秘められた破壊力が爆発する！ 人気アイドルの真実を描く、感動の芸能界ストーリー！

Titles.jpn: がんばれ浦島太郎
ソードマスターヤマト－誤植篇－－完結篇－
なめられペリー

Summaries.jpn: アメリカ国使ペリーは、1853年、鎖国の日本に来訪した。ペリー拳の使い手にして偉大なるペリー提督…。だが意外なことに、ペリーはコンテー大尉をはじめとする乗組員たち（小ヤギや実の娘含む）から、なめられまくっていたのです!? 記念すべき第1回コミック連載作品をアニメ化！ これが『ギャグ日』の原点です！

Titles.jpn: ラヴ江
狂暴エイリアン

Summaries.jpn: 宇宙ステーション。それは、宇宙に浮かぶたった1つのオアシス。だが、20XX年。その宇宙ステーションに、危険なエイリアンが侵入してしまった！ ステーションのスタッフたちの運命は!? 映像化不可能と言われたあのハードSFを完全映像化します!!!

Titles.jpn: 伊能忠敬の歩み
富士山

Summaries.jpn: 飛鳥時代。少しスゴイことをすれば、“日本で最初にそれを行った人”となれる可能性が高かった…。聖徳太子と小野妹子は、もっとも聖なる山である富士山登頂を目指して出発する！ だが、そこには思いもかけないライバルが…??? 一番最初に富士山に登った人は誰なのか？ 歴史の真実が、今、明かされる！

Titles.jpn: ララ美☆リアリティ／聖徳なぞなぞ傑作選

Titles.eng: Because She's a Famous Detective! Usami-chan
Titles.jpn: 名探偵なので！うさみちゃん

Summaries.jpn: 動物小学校4年生のうさみちゃんは何でも解決する名探偵だよ。うさみちゃんのクラスに新たな転校生がやってきたんだ。それもクマ吉君の待望する女の子、女子、女生徒だよ！ でも、巨大なハサミを持った、その転校生は!? デジカメとプリンターと鋭い傷のナゾとは??? うさみちゃんの名推理＆通報が始まるよ！

Titles.jpn: 恋の季節!!キューピッド君
陰陽師

Summaries.jpn: ナゼか建設されることとなったナゾの高速道路予定地に10年前から出現する幽霊！ 天才陰陽師、阿部への依頼は、その幽霊退治だった。町で一番の空手家、太郎君とともに森の中の洋館へと向かった阿部が見たものは!? 恐るべき幽霊と、阿部の式神たちの激闘が始まる！

Titles.jpn: 名探偵すぎるよ！うさみちゃん

Summaries.eng:
A major mystery hits Animal Elementary!
Sarutaro-kun’s gym uniform has been stolen!
But there’s no way Kumakichi-kun would steal a boy’s uniform...
So who’s the real culprit!?
Could this be the first-ever case where Kumakichi-kun isn't guilty!?
Summaries.jpn:
“男の子の”サル太郎くんの体操服が盗まれて
どうぶつ小学校騒然！ だってクマ吉くんが
男の子の体操服を盗むなんてあり得ないんだもの！

Titles.jpn: ブレーメンの音楽隊

Summaries.eng:
A famous German folktale gets the Gag Manga Biyori twist!
A rooster, cat, dog, horse, and... a chupacabra(?!), team up to drive out a thief!
Even with the surprise cryptid, the gang decides to work together...
....Wait, stop sucking blood!
Summaries.jpn:
ドイツの有名な童話が『ギャグマンガ日和』テイストで登場！
みんなで力を合わせて泥棒を追い出そうとする雄鶏、猫、犬、馬、チュパカブラの５匹…チュ、チュパカブラ！？
突然のＵＭＡに困惑するも、とりあえず協力することになるが…。
ちょ、血吸うのやめて！

Titles.eng: The Narrow Road to Oku Episode 2: Departure / Lost on the Narrow Road
Titles.jpn: 奥の細道 エピソード2 旅立ち／迷子の細道

Summaries.eng:
Two episodes from the Narrow Road to Oku arc!
First up, Basho sets off on his journey.
Later, deep in the forest, Sora-kun ditches him right after saying,
“If you’re scared, just write some haiku.”
Now lost and uninspired, Basho faces something worse—
a sudden attack from a masked weirdo!?
Summaries.jpn:
エピソード「奥の細道」より、2本立て！
1本目は、旅の出発を描いた物語。
2本目は、森の中が舞台。曽良くんから「迷子で怖い時は俳句を詠めば気が紛れるよ」と助言された直後、まさかの置き去りに！迷子の迷子の芭蕉さん、俳句を詠もうとするもいい句がなかなか浮かばない…。
そんな中、突然現れたお面を被った怖い奴に襲われて…！？

Titles.jpn: 麻雀

Summaries.eng:
Tonight, men gather ‘round the table...
The underworld's strongest face off in the world of Mahjong!
There’s just one problem...
None of them know the rules!!
A legendary fan-favorite finally animated!
“Hey pal, you're totally see-through!”
Summaries.jpn:
今宵、漢たちが卓を囲む――
裏の世界の強者どもが集う、漢の世界『麻雀』。
ただ、彼らにとって些細な問題がひとつ。それは、誰一人としてルールを知らなかったのである…！
ファン待望の伝説回、ついにアニメ化！
あンたら、背中がスケスケだぜ？

Titles.jpn: 聖徳太子伝説 太子の眉間から一筋の光

Summaries.eng:
One day, Shotoku Taishi won’t stop poking his forehead.
Why? Some legend he doesn’t remember says it used to glow.
He turns to a fairy-tale forest owl for help,
but gets lost in the woods with Imoko, who just wants him back at work!
Can Taishi shine with holy dignity at last!?
Summaries.jpn:
あくる日、ひたすら額をグリグリする、キモうす気味悪い聖徳太子の姿ありけり。
なんでも、身に覚えのない聖徳太子伝説で「額から光を出した」とあるとかなんとか。
森の物知り博士フクロウさんという突然メルヘンな存在を頼り出す太子と、太子に仕事をさせたい妹子は、いつの間にか森の奥深くへ迷い込んで…。
果たして、太子はピカピカを放って威厳を出せるのか！？

Titles.jpn: ヘンゼルとグレーテル

Summaries.eng: Grimm’s fairy tales meet Gag Manga Biyori! Hansel and Gretel find the candy house, but while Gretel feasts, Hansel just keeps licking the candy window. Even after being caught, he won’t stop licking! As he licks on, Gretel begins her escape plan!
Summaries.jpn:
グリム童話が『ギャグマンガ日和』テイストで登場！
森をさまよったヘンゼルとグレーテルはお菓子の家を発見。
様々なお菓子を堪能するグレーテルをよそに、兄のヘンゼルは窓になっているアメを舐める！ひたすら舐める！捕まっても舐める！！
アメを舐め続ける兄を置いて、グレーテルの脱出計画が始まる！

Titles.jpn: Idol Group

Summaries.eng: I’m Saki Ushiyama! A barely-known, ultra-energetic idol! To become a trendy influencer, I get a smartphone and rush to the agency. Turns out they thought I quit! No worries! I crash a new idol group’s meeting to, uh… totally join them!

Titles.jpn: 聖徳太子の六角堂

Summaries.eng: “Temple Builder Extraordinaire” Shotoku Taishitotally forgot about the hexagonal temple he built. He takes Imoko to check it out... but it’s completely run-down! The real-life temple's first head monk was Imoko… So what will this version of Imoko do?

Titles.jpn: バッド・キャッツ ―BAD CATS―

Summaries.eng: We’re the infamous “BAD CATS”! A noble band of flashy thieves! But our teammate Naoko, who knows where we hid the loot, got kidnapped! No worries - she’s wearing a huge tracking device from a junk shop! So what if it’s obvious? Naoko’ll bluff her way through!

Titles.eng: The Narrow Road to Oku: The Last Spurt
Titles.jpn: 奥の細道ラストスパート

Summaries.eng: Basho and Sora-kun's journey is almost over. Then suddenly, a new guy, Hokushi, joins in after Sora-kun randomly makes him Basho’s disciple! He picks up Sora-kun’s tough-love style fast… and somehow ends up even stricter than Sora-kun!? Don’t miss the epic climax of The Narrow Road to Oku!

Titles.jpn: 陰陽師探偵対学校の怪談

Summaries.eng: Master exorcist Abe-san visits a prestigious elementary school…Hauntings called the “Seven Mysteries” plague the place! With the principal and his shikigami in tow, Abe investigates...but this ghost-fearing onmyoji is not prepared for what he sees!

Titles.eng: Seemingly a Great Detective! Usami-chan: Goodbye, Kumakichi-kun / She Really a Great Detective! Usami-chan
Titles.jpn: 名探偵とおぼしき！うさみちゃん-さよならクマ吉君-／やっぱり名探偵！うさみちゃん

Summaries.eng: “Farewell… Kumakichi-kun.” The king of all pervy crimes is finally moving away! But what’s his final scandal before he goes? And just how peaceful does the town get afterward? Meanwhile, Usami-chan senses something fishy before the field trip…A preemptive report!? What’s she onto this time!?
